about: Every dated figure RightDue quotes, in one place (grill #35, sprint G4). Each entry names its source, the date it was last checked against that source (as_of), how often it must be re-checked (cadence_days) and how (auto = a script or workflow refreshes it; by_hand = a person re-reads the source). engine/tests/test_data_freshness.py fails when any entry is older than as_of + cadence_days + grace_days, or when a code constant no longer matches the value here. Figures that already live in their own dated data file are listed with `file` + `as_of_key` and read from that file, so nothing is copied twice. Every entry of web/src/lib/market-data.json is included automatically (see market_data_cadence_days). To refresh a by_hand entry: re-read the source, update the value in code AND here, and set as_of to the day you checked.
